description: This file manages session state for an isolated agent in a cron job, including persisting session entries, updating skills snapshots, and synchronizing live session selections.

methods.name: createPersistCronSessionEntry
methods.description: Creates a function to persist the current cron session, updating the session store unless in a fast test environment.

methods.name: persistCronSkillsSnapshotIfChanged
methods.description: Updates the session entry with a new skills snapshot if it has changed and persists the session.

methods.name: markCronSessionPreRun
methods.description: Marks the session entry as pre-run with specified provider and model.

methods.name: syncCronSessionLiveSelection
methods.description: Synchronizes the session entry with the live session selection, including handling auth profile overrides.
